newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine CEI sells Telefonica a TV stake.
newsitem.headline: Argentine CEI sells Telefonica a TV stake.

text.p: Argentina's CEI Citicorp Holdings said Tuesday it had accepted an offer from Spain's Telefonica to buy its 22.5 percent stake in local cable television operator Multicanal for $239 million.

CEI said in a letter to the Buenos Aires stock exchange 70 percent of the sale price would be paid on signature of the contract and the remainder in two payments nine and 18 months after the deal is completed.
CEI owns the Multicanal stake through its controlled firms Compania de Inversiones en Cable SA, Invercab SA and Citicorp Argentine Investment Company.

The company signed preliminary purchase agreements in late July with Tele-Communications International Inc and local media tycoon Eduardo Eurnekian for a total 64.5 percent of another major Argentine cable TV operator, Cablevision.
It also acquired 33.34 percent of sports TV operator and producer Torneos y Competencias SA.
